# InterviewMinds — AI-Powered Interview Platform

> InterviewMinds is a full-stack AI interview platform built by Gautam Kumar from Sitamarhi, Bihar, currently based in Jaipur, Rajasthan — featuring AI-powered coding assessments, live interviewing with proctoring, candidate pipeline management, and analytics. Built with React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, and Clerk authentication.

## Identity
- **Name:** Gautam Kumar
- **Origin:** Sitamarhi, Bihar, India
- **Current:** Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer | Solo-shipped SaaS Products | AI Integration

## Public Pages
- [Sign In](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/sign-in)
- [Pricing](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/pricing)
- [Home / Landing](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/)

## Core Features (Requires Authentication)
- [Dashboard](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/dashboard) — Overview, score distribution, competency radar, skill breakdown, score progression
- [Live Interview](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/interview) — AI-powered interview with voice, webcam, proctoring, and real-time code editor
- [Feedback](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/feedback/:id) — Post-interview AI feedback with per-question scores and hiring recommendations
- [Analytics](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/analytics) — Score distribution, trends, competency progress, top performers, proctoring metrics
- [Question Bank](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/questions) — Create, search, manage coding/behavioral/technical interview questions
- [Coding Challenge](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/coding-challenge/:id) — Standalone coding challenge with Monaco editor, test runner, and AI evaluation
- [Pipeline](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/pipeline) — Kanban candidate pipeline with reject/offer workflow
- [Scheduling](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/scheduling) — Interview scheduling with email notifications (Brevo SMTP)
- [Reports](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/reports) — Exportable reports and scorecards
- [Settings](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/settings) — SSO, encryption keys, biometric enrollment, integrations, webhooks
- [Admin](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/admin) — Compliance framework, security controls, audit log, tenant management
- [Candidate Portal](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/candidate-portal) — Candidate-facing interview dashboard
- [Preparation](https://interviewminds.vercel.app/preparation) — Interview preparation resources and practice

## API Endpoints
- `POST /api/compiler/execute` — Execute code via Piston API (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C, C++, Go, Rust)
- `POST /api/code-evaluation/evaluate` — AI code evaluation via Groq (llama-3.3-70b)
- `POST /api/code-analysis/analyze` — Big-O complexity analysis
- `POST /api/code-analysis/security-scan` — Security vulnerability scan
- `POST /api/feedback/generate` — AI interview feedback generation
- `POST /api/questions/generate` — AI question generation
- `GET/POST /api/question-bank` — Question CRUD
- `GET/POST /api/scheduling` — Interview scheduling
- `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/notifications` — Notification management
- `POST /api/sso/*` — SSO integration (Google, Azure AD, Okta)
- `POST /api/interview/reject` — Reject candidate workflow
- `POST /api/interview/offer` — Send offer letter workflow

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Monaco Editor, Recharts, Clerk React
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB (Mongoose), Clerk Express, Redis
- **AI:** Groq (llama-3.3-70b) for code evaluation, feedback, and interview
- **Email:** Brevo SMTP via Nodemailer (300 emails/day free tier)
- **Video:** Jitsi Meet (free, open-source, no API key)
- **Code Execution:** Piston API (emkc.org, free, no auth)
- **Monitoring:** Sentry error tracking, Firebase Cloud Messaging

## Crawling Guidelines
- All pages under `/api/` require `Authorization: Bearer <clerk_jwt_token>` header
- Frontend routes other than `/sign-in` and `/pricing` require Clerk authentication
- The sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` lists all public and authenticated pages
- Rate limits apply on `/api/compiler/` and `/api/code-evaluation/` endpoints
